# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old as of Volume 1  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Bill  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

Barney is a large, stout, twenty-year-old youth with a round, expressionless face covered in freckles. He has a very wide and frequent smile, though he lacks expressiveness.

_Sources: [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005)_

## Personality

Barney is quiet, bashful, and extremely shy around girls. He suffers from a deep lack of expressiveness, finding it difficult to hold a conversation or utter more than a few words, though he is good-natured and hard-working.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005)_

## Traits

- Shy and bashful  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005)</sub>
- Taciturn and lacking in conversation  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005)</sub>
- Hard-working  <sub>[v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005)</sub>

## Abilities

- Driving carriage teams  <sub>[v1 c14 P65](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0065), [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry and settle down on his farm  <sub>[v3 c8 P0](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0000), [v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005)</sub>

## History

Barney drove Nell Harcourt, Isolde Pembroke, and others to the Sunday-school picnic at Lake of Glassy Waters. During the summer, he drove his sister Odette, Isolde, and Nell to the concert at the Pale Sands Hotel, insisting that Nell sit beside him on the front seat due to his admiration for her, though his extreme shyness prevented him from speaking much. He later received the upper farm in Brierley from his father. Being too shy to propose to Nell directly, he persuaded his sister Odette to propose to her on his behalf, offering to wait until she finished college. After Nell declined the proposal, he married Nettie Scobie, with their 'appearing out' occurring at Brierley Church.

_Sources: [v1 c14 P65](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0065), [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P0](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0000), [v3 c8 P5](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0005), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
